# Laravel LLM Full Configuration
# Complete configuration for Laravel LLM integration

# ==========================================
# Application Settings
# ==========================================

app:
  name: "ASE Technologies"
  url: "https://asetechnologies.in"
  description: "ASE Technologies - Digital Marketing & Web Solutions"
  version: "1.0.0"
  environment: "production"

# ==========================================
# LLM Provider Configuration
# ==========================================

provider:
  name: "openai"
  type: "chat"
  model: "gpt-4o-mini"
  temperature: 0.7
  max_tokens: 4096

  # API Configuration
  api_key: "YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY_HERE"
  organization: "YOUR_OPENAI_ORG_ID_HERE"

# ==========================================
# Feature Flags
# ==========================================

features:
  chat: true
  knowledge_base: true
  code_assistance: true
  sentiment_analysis: true
  summarization: true
  translation: true
  function_calling: true

# ==========================================
# Knowledge Base Configuration
# ==========================================

knowledge_base:
  enabled: true
  vector_store: "pinecone"
  embedding_model: "text-embedding-3-small"
  chunk_size: 500
  chunk_overlap: 50
  similarity_threshold: 0.7

# ==========================================
# Chat Configuration
# ==========================================

chat:
  max_history: 50
  session_timeout: 3600
  welcome_message: "Hello! How can I help you with ASE Technologies today?"
  fallback_message: "I'm sorry, I don't have an answer for that. Please contact our support team."

# ==========================================
# Security & Rate Limiting
# ==========================================

security:
  rate_limit: 100
  tokens_per_minute: 2000
  allowed_origins:
    - "https://asetechnologies.in"
    - "http://localhost:3000"

# ==========================================
# Integration Settings
# ==========================================

integrations:
  analytics: true
  crm: false
  email_marketing: true
  support_ticket: true

# ==========================================
# Multilingual Support
# ==========================================

i18n:
  default_locale: "en"
  supported_locales: ["en", "es", "fr", "de", "hi"]
  translation_provider: "openai"

# ==========================================
# Monitoring & Logging
# ==========================================

monitoring:
  enabled: true
  log_level: "info"
  sentry_dsn: "YOUR_SENTRY_DSN_HERE"

# ==========================================
# Contact & Support
# ==========================================

support:
  email: "support@ase-technologies.com"
  phone: "+91-XXXX-XXXXXX"
  working_hours: "9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST"
  chat_widget_id: "your-chat-widget-id"
